en: A vintage stereoscopic postcard showing two identical side‑by‑side images of an ancient stone triumphal arch with three openings above and a large central archway below. Two people in early 20th‑century clothing stand in front of it. Through the opening of the arch, columns of a classical temple are visible in the background. Greek text is printed below the images, and a website watermark (www.elia.org.gr) appears across the right image.
